up: Retrieve all activity records associated with the assay whose chembl_id is 'CHEMBL1614250'. For each activity, include the compound's ChEMBL identifier (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), the standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, pchembl value, and the activity ID. Do not apply any additional filters (e.g., do not restrict by relation type, confidence score, or unit). Return one row per activity record, preserving all rows.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value, a.activity_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614250';
